t: An open software defined radio that listens from 100 kHz to 6 GHz.
steps: Buy HackRF Pro from a reseller such as NooElec, SparkFun or Hacker Warehouse.
Get a USB-C cable and a wideband SMA antenna, as neither comes in the box.
Install the HackRF host tools from the official docs.
Plug it in and run hackrf_info to confirm your computer sees it.
Install SDR++ and pick HackRF as the source.
Tune to a local FM station and watch the waterfall.
Stay in receive-only mode unless you hold an amateur radio license.
meta: Wild Open. From $400. A few stores.
